title: allow `slicer check --root WT; echo exit=$?` style exit-code capture for read-only roles, or document that plain invocation is required

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-143743-1548, project ork, item S340:

allow `slicer check --root WT; echo exit=$?` style exit-code capture for read-only roles, or document that plain invocation is required

Evidence: "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs" denied both slicer check and adj lint with `$?`
